site.tagline: Tools to build your own palettes.
settings.title: Settings
common.exportCspTitle: Downloads a .zip with the color set (.aco) and an image of the palette
common.acoDownloaded: Downloaded. Drag the .aco onto the Color Set palette
common.genMin: The generator needs at least {min} colors
common.genContinue: Keep working on this palette in the generator
gap.warn: some values are only {gap} apart and may blur together.
gen.description: Palette generator based on hue harmonies, with the option of giving each color its own value step for chiaroscuro drawing. Part of Palettekit.
gen.lede: Palettes built on hue harmonies. Step the values and each color takes its own rung, from the brightest light to the deepest shadow: made for chiaroscuro portraits.
gen.keepHint: Changing a control adjusts the current palette without changing its hues. Generate, the harmony or the temperature roll new hues.
gen.scaleHint: Each color takes its own value step. Without it, each one gets a random value within the range.
gen.distHint: For chiaroscuro, low key leaves more nuance in the shadows.
gen.muteHint: Lowers the saturation of the lightest and darkest colors, as real light does.
gen.sphereLabel: A sphere lit from the upper left, painted only with the palette's colors
gen.tip1: Highlight: the shine on the forehead, nose and cheekbones.
gen.tip2: The middle value goes on the line where light turns into shadow.
gen.tip3: The darkest one for cast shadows and the background.
gen.historyEmpty: Palettes you generate will show up here. Tap one to bring it back.
gen.dropped_one: A locked color was released: it didn't fit the scale
gen.dropped_other: {n} locked colors were released: they didn't fit the scale
photo.description: Pull the colors out of a reference image, sorted from light to shadow, and see it painted with only those colors. Part of Palettekit.
photo.lede: Pull the colors out of a reference, sorted from light to shadow, and see how it looks painted with only those. The image is processed in your browser: it isn't uploaded anywhere.
photo.dropHint: or drop it here, or paste it with Ctrl+V
photo.posterLabel: The image repainted with only the palette's colors
photo.posterEmpty: Load an image to see it painted with only the extracted colors.
photo.recolorHint: Same values and saturations as the photo, with the hues of a new harmony.
photo.empty: The image's colors will show up here, from lightest to darkest.
photo.notImage: That doesn't look like an image
photo.recoloredAnnounce: New colors with the photo's values
photo.noteRecolored: Recolored: same values, saturations and proportions as the photo.
photo.noteLimit: The generator works with up to {max}: it takes the {max} that cover the most.
create.description: Build a palette by hand, at random or by pasting hex, and take it away as an image, a link or a Clip Studio color set. Part of Palettekit.
create.lede: Build a palette by hand: start at random, from hex pasted from anywhere or from scratch, and take it away as an image, a link or a color set.
create.pasteHint: Works with what "Copy hex" gives you in the other tools, a palette link or any text with hex colors (CSS, comma lists…). Up to 24.
create.linkHint: The link opens this exact palette: the page address updates with every change.
create.noHex: No hex colors found in that text
create.genFirst: The generator works with up to {max}: it takes the first {max}
create.linkCopied: Link copied: it opens this exact palette
